ownerNote.text:
FOR THE OWNER: WHICH LOOK FEELS LIKE HAMIDO?

A, B and C are the same website: same menu, same pickup ordering, same pages. Only the look and feel change.

• A — Corniche: warm stone, tiles, elegant menu board.
• B — Anfushi market: painted shop sign, fish on ice with price tags, bold colors.
• C — A mix of both.

→ The full website in each look (all 9 pages) is to the right: one row per look. The original v2 pages are still on the left.

The striped boxes are where your own photos go: the fish on ice, the grill, the table, the storefront.

handoff.text:
ENGINEER HANDOFF (v4)

• Design system: ‘Ibn Hamido — Orland Park’ (Theme menu). CSS vars in each page’s <helmet> match token names 1:1. Fonts: Young Serif 400 (never bold), Inter 400/500/600, Aref Ruqaa (Arabic: lang="ar" dir="rtl", always paired with English). Blue #2B4AA5 primary; turquoise #1F9AA0 secondary; #0F6E73 for small turquoise text. Form errors use #B42318.

• MENU DATA: menu-data.json is the source of truth. 5 categories: Fresh Catch by the lb (F-01…06) · Hamido Combos (CB-01…06) · Signature (SG-01…13) · Sandwiches (SW-01…05) · Salads & Sides (SD-01…12). Names, descriptions and Arabic category labels come from the JSON. Item IDs = shot IDs. Old L-/S- IDs are retired.
• PRICES: every price is a [PRICE] placeholder until the owner confirms. Build as POS/CMS-driven fields. refPriceAstoria never appears in the UI (gray sticky is internal only).

• ORDERING FLOW (pickup only, paid online): /order → item options sheet → cart drawer → /order/checkout → /order/confirmed. Every Order / Order pickup CTA goes to /order.
  – Status open | lunch | closed drives the banner; closed disables all Add buttons and checkout.
  – combosLunchOnly (default off): off = combos all day; on = combos orderable only Mon–Fri [LUNCH HOURS], with the lunch banner and badges.
  – onlineByWeight (default on): off replaces the fish grid with an in-store info card (“pick your fish at the counter”).
• OPTION GROUPS:
  – Combos: Preparation (Grilled / Fried) only on CB-04, CB-05, CB-06. Combo Sides (pick 2): steppers on SD-01…09, counter “0 / 2”, repeats allowed, error if not exactly 2.
  – Sandwiches + SG-11 Fish & Chips: Side (pick 1): Fries · Potato Chips Classic · BBQ · Salt & Vinegar · Sour Cream & Onion.
  – SG-02 Red Snapper: Grilled / Fried. SD-01 Rice: Small / Medium / Large.
  – Every sheet has quantity + special instructions.
• DIRECT-ADD ITEMS: anything with no option group adds straight to the cart with an “Added · Undo” toast (6 s, aria-live polite); no sheet.
• FRESH CATCH: weight chips 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 / Other (0.5 lb stepper up to [MAX LB]); styles limited per fish (fish.styles); optional side steppers; live breakdown “weight × ([PRICE]/lb + [PRICE]/lb cooking) + style = Est. [PRICE]”. Sold out today = fish.availableToday false. Any by-the-lb line turns the total into “Estimated total” + the weighing note.
• WEIGHT-ADJUSTED PAYMENT: checkout authorises the estimated total + [AUTH BUFFER %]; the POS captures the final amount after weighing and sends a receipt with the actual weight. Confirmation marks fresh-catch lines “Est., final after weighing”. [VERIFY: POS supports weight-adjusted capture.]
  – Sold-out state per item. Sheet = modal on desktop, bottom sheet under 600px; cart = right drawer, full screen on mobile, sticky “View order (n) · [SUBTOTAL]” bar under 900px. Both focus-trapped, Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger.
  – openPanel tweak: none | cart | comboSheet | sidesError | sandwichSheet | catchSheet (Order, A_/B_/L_Order, MobileOrder).
• CART persists across pages (mockup: localStorage key ihs-order-v4; production: the POS cart/session).
• PAYMENT: no real payments in the mockup. Checkout has a [POS PAYMENT EMBED] slot. Pickup only; no delivery in the UI.

• launchMode (Nav, Home, Visit): on = top-bar “Opening [OPENING DATE]” + hero chip; off after launch = “Open today [HOURS]” computed from the hours data. Not hard-coded.

• SMS: every phone field used for texts gets the UNTICKED marketing consent checkbox (exact copy in SPEC §5.1). Checkout has a separate, unticked order-update checkbox. Both link to /privacy (Privacy & SMS Terms, also in the footer); needed for SMS registration.

• MOTION: prefers-reduced-motion = no review autoplay, no slide/scale/reveal transitions, Story chapters static. Reviews: visible Pause/Play, pause on hover and focus-within, aria-live="polite" only after manual prev/next/dot. Cooking styles open on click/tap only, inside a fixed-height reveal (no layout jump). Dish accordion: hover switches after 150ms intent; click/tap always works.
• NAV: links collapse into a Menu button + accessible drawer below 900px.

• JSON-LD (Home + Visit <head>):
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Restaurant","name":"Ibn Hamido Seafood","url":"https://ibnhamidochicago.com","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","streetAddress":"14035 LaGrange Rd","addressLocality":"Orland Park","addressRegion":"IL","postalCode":"60462","addressCountry":"US"},"telephone":"[PHONE]","openingHours":"[HOURS]","servesCuisine":["Egyptian","Seafood","Mediterranean"],"hasMenu":"https://ibnhamidochicago.com/menu","acceptsReservations":false}

• PHOTOS: AI concept images are in the mockups until launch (canvas asset store, /_blob/… URLs). Each carries an ‘AI concept’ tag and its own REPLACE BEFORE LAUNCH row in the Content checklist. ST-02…05 and V-01 (family, Astoria, Orland Park storefront) are owner photos only: tagged ‘Stand-in’. Slots keep their size, arch crop and radius; photos use object-fit: cover. MAP stays a Google Maps embed.
• OG IMAGE: <meta property="og:image" content="/_blob/e4c176019269a988c47be4a1688c49ef"> (OG-01, 1200×630, AI concept, REPLACE BEFORE LAUNCH). Also twitter:image. Not shown on any page.
• PLACEHOLDERS: anything in [BRACKETS] and every striped box is a CMS field. Shot IDs on every slot map to the Content checklist board.
• Pages are fluid: 1200px container, 48px gutters desktop / 16px mobile. Mobile checks at 390px are in the bottom row.
